textRuns.value: The date slicer does not change the score: it was calculated once for the whole period in v_restaurant_performance. Filter this page with the score table's city, not dim_city. dim_city is linked only to orders, so a second city path would be ambiguous. Lowest scores on the export include Royal Grill (Delhi, score 0.054, cancel rate 37.5%) and Royal Kitchen (Visakhapatnam, 0.084, 40%). Highest include Green Corner (Chandigarh, 0.988, cancel rate 9.1%). Apply a Top N filter of 10 in Desktop for the short list.
